PhD Early Admissions Scheme
PhD Early Admissions Scheme
About the Scheme
The PhD Early Admissions Scheme (PhD-EAS) is an elite program created by the ECE department for outstanding students from top universities in China to enter the PhD research early and directly. The PhD-EAS mainly targets Year 3 Undergraduate students. Currently, our partner universities include
Beihang University
Fudan University
Harbin Institute of Technology
Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen
Huazhong University of Science and Technology
Nanjing University
Nankai University
Peking University
Shanghai Jiao Tong University
South China University of Technology
Southeast University
Sun Yat-sen University
Tsinghua University
University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
University of Science and Technology of China
Xi'an Jiao Tong University
Xidian University
Zhejiang University
Over the past years, PhD-EAS students have made outstanding achievements in frontier research. Many PhD-EAS students were awarded Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS). Undergraduates with strong academic profile and research motivation are encouraged to apply for the PhD-EAS through their home universities.
Application
Home university/ institution to nominate top Undergraduate students
Application form to be completed by nominees
ECE faculty members to interview candidates in two rounds
Successful candidates to be informed and asked for acceptance
PhD-EAS exercise starts in February to March every year. Interested students should ask their home schools about the application. Inquiries can be also sent to eceeas@ust.hk.
